tips.text: Run the Abyssal Zone on Steel Path if you can clear it; each beacon pays about 45% more Vainthorn and adds Steel Essence.
Rotate the host in a premade squad; only the host's beacon is spent and everyone gets the full reward.
Recruit a premade squad; the mission has no public matchmaking, so an open squad never fills.
Carry just one Defixio to extraction; extra ones add nothing because the payout is one flat roll per run.
Grab the nearest Defixio, drop it at extraction, and let the remaining enemies come to you.
Spend banked standing on beacons; buying them never touches the daily cap, and every Rank 2 syndicate's stockpile adds up.
Pick up the Defixio with your Warframe, switch to Operator to walk it to extraction, then switch back to deposit it without the curse.
Use Loot Radar, Golden Instinct or Orokin Eye to find Defixios; the hiding Syndicate agents also mark one on your minimap.
Bring a shieldless or health-tank frame such as Inaros, Kullervo or Nidus so the Exposure Curse does not matter.
Keep the beacon owner in the squad; if the host quits or disconnects, the mission fails for everyone.
Finish the objectives before stepping onto extraction in a solo run; it ends the mission at once.
Grab your Defixio early on Steel Path; Acolytes may make an uncollected one vanish and block the finish.
Farm the 80 Vainthorn for Dorrclave in the same session as Dagath while your beacons are stocked.
Expect a boring but reliable farm: every run pays Vainthorn, and both Dagath and Dorrclave take about three relaxed hours.
